clips.title: The story
paras: The Scourge is an apocalyptic army of undead monsters, necromancers, and enslaved spirits bound to the will of the Lich King. Originally created by the Burning Legion to destabilize Azeroth ahead of the Third War, the legion of walking corpses broke free from demonic control and shattered the kingdoms of Lordaeron and Quel'Thalas. Today, they wage unending war from their arctic stronghold in Northrend and their corrupt dominion over the Plaguelands.

The Scourge was born as an instrument of destruction forged by the Burning Legion. The demon lords bound the spirit of the fallen orc shaman Ner'zhul to the Frozen Throne in distant Northrend, fashioning him into the Lich King. With terrifying telepathic power, he was commanded to prepare Azeroth for conquest. The Lich King unleashed the Plague of Undeath southward into the unsuspecting human realm of Lordaeron, relying on the mortal traitors of the Cult of the Damned to poison grain supplies. Those who perished arose not as restful dead, but as twisted thralls entirely subservient to the Lich King's iron mind.
